_comment: Deliberate exceptions, per kit/DESIGN-STANDARD.md Part IV slop gate. Each entry states why; none is a blanket ignore.

exceptions.why: body{overflow-x:hidden} is the three-viewport law's mandated backstop (DESIGN-STANDARD law 1). It clips horizontally only; the one popover on the page (the phone menu) lives in the sticky header and opens downward, so nothing needs to escape sideways.
